svg.text: Hình 3.2 – Cấu trúc các mô-đun backend và luồng gọi API của hệ thống
Every route below was read from app.py, auth.py, admin_bp.py and correction_bp.py
Server-rendered admin pages and login form
SECRET_KEY · MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH · session-cookie flags · LoginManager + user_loader
unauthorized_handler (401 JSON / redirect) · RequestEntityTooLarge → 413 · after_request no-cache
register_blueprint(auth_bp, admin_bp, correction_bp) · vn_time Jinja filter

Call-flow rule visible in the code: the browser never reaches a model or the database directly. Every request enters Flask, is checked by @login_required (and @admin_required for /admin), is resolved to an owned Document, and only then
reaches the service layer; persistence happens exclusively through models.py. The OCR routes never import an OCR library themselves — they call smart_ocr_service → ocr_service → router → adapter.
